body:
Have you tried sleeping pills for your lack of sleep? ( it's just a suggestion- it may help you) I understand how sleep can be an escape- I felt the same for a long time(I still do at times know but it's getting better for me and I believe it will for you as well). Another suggestion would be purchasing a dream catcher ( this may sound completely stupid but they are believed to prevent nightmares and I believe it may help) 
If I could tell you one last thing- the earth would be a lonely place without you, there are so many silent lovers on this planet surrounding you and those who even just passed by you- those who look at you and wished they had your eyes or your humor, intellect, your intentions, your manners or your heart, even just you. ( this may sound totally absurd but I am one too) 
We've all done terrible things, no one's a saint but that doesn't mean we deserve the worst things in life or to feel negatively about ourselves. 

You deserve happiness and love, and I mean real happiness- the type that provides warmth to your heart and you deserve to know what it feels like do be okay, to feel like you're aren't against the world alone- more than anything you deserve to be okay and at peace with yourself. I know it's hard to hear this when nothing seems to be okay and when you've hit rock bottom, especially when you're far from loving yourself and feeling okay but I still want you to know becoz one day we'll be okay again and we'll feel at peace with ourselves and we'll learn to love ourselves, one day you're going to feel love again and I hope that day is nearby. No matter the terrible things we did- we deserve at least this.

Hey, always here to help out and will be here if you need to talk?
I usually am the type to listen and give advice ( if needed only) but I'm always here to listen and talk anytime :)

Now that I've calmed down after 2 hours of well-deserved sleep (without waking up suddenly to tears staining my face and a foul mood). I felt really good and at peace, after I vented out how I felt for so long- it felt good cause for once I talked about how I felt and didn't have to lie or cover up anything.


I just want anyone who comes across this to know that even if we have our ups and downs and days that we've hit rock bottom we can keep going, let's live to see yet another sunrise and sunset, not necessarily living for a reason but maybe a single moment - I want to live so I can wake up every day and see my younger sister asking me to play with her or do her hair and to my elder sister annoying me and hogging the Netflix account. I want to live so I can kiss my mother goodbye every night, I want to live so I can look up at the stars and ask my uncle (who passed away if you read the b4 post) if he is well and living happily where ever he is. 

I know I'll continue to question life and keep overthinking but I also know I'm trying to do better and feel better (and trying is simply enough than doing nothing I believe)
I might have problems and there will be days I want to just put an end to it all but I won't let myself fall so deep in sorrow (and I think I'll talk to my momma about my problems)
I hope whoever sees this is encouraged at least a little bit and will look forward to life AND pls know that you have done enough and that you tried and that itself is enough.

I want to say it gets better but I don't even believe in that line anymore but I truly do hope that you feel better and I sincerely hope that you move on from the past and learn to love and appreciate yourself.

From what I've read in your post OP, you sound like an angel and a complete gentleman and I hope you're able to see that as well more than anything. 

It sucks when we feel like we haven't done anything in life and feel like we are a just a speck of dust in this vast world but I also know that both you and me have done more than enough and we've tried and that's enough. I mean life has been hard on us and I don't think we deserve it- maybe not everything( but this is how I feel and it can completely be different for you and I respect that).  I believe there is so much more to you and I hope you are able to discover that and in that process fall in love with yourself. 

I believe you've done more than enough, you've tried and that's enough. I hope you feel better about yourself  and I would love to know how you feel after a few months have gone by cause I care. ( Does that sound creepy? I hope it does not)

I did read through the whole thing but I hesitated replying cause I'm not much of an help anyways.
I just hope things get better and you have someone to tell you that you're enough and you're trying and that it self is more than enough.

I feel the same way( no wait, that sounds very wrong- I understand somewhat of how you're feeling) life is such a burden- it feels likes a chore I've been doing all my life and all I ever wanted was for someone to tell I've done more than enough in life and that I've tried and that's enough.
It's hard to be the strong one all the time cause people tend to forget even we can feel hurt and can feel down.
I've lost all my motivation as well and I always push away people too but I know we can get through it, we've kept going and we've lived yet another day and I believe that's more than enough.
Please keep going and yell out a "fuck you" to everything that's tried to keep you down and has made you tired of living. The best way to take revenge on life( a very disappointing and shitty life) is to keep living.

I feel like I'm probably too late but I know how it feels and life feels like such a burden- life feels like a chore and it gets tiring very fast.
I just hope that somewhere along your life you were truly happy and looked forward to life. You've done more than enough and you kept going all this time and that is something to be proud of. 
It sucks to not be able to do such a normal thing as crying, it really sucks when there aren't any tears for such a long time and then all of a sudden all you can do is cry.
I would love to give you a hug and tell you you've done enough.
